title: docs(skills): objectstack-ui teaches who sees an app (tabPermissions) and who may open it (requiredPermissions)
body:
Part of #32587

Refs #32587 (Wanted items 1, 3, 4 and 5). Wanted item 2 stays on the card: the sentence "More audiences are `requiredPermissions`-gated groups **inside** that one app, never a second app." and the module-owned app teaching are held behind #32585 (the ADR-0019 D3 amendment, not merged), per triage comment 6816962062. That sentence is byte-identical in this diff, and nothing added here teaches a second app inside one `type: 'app'` package.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`objectstack-ui` 的 `rules/navigation.md` 新增「Who sees or opens an app」一节,教四件事:权限集 `tabPermissions` 设 `hidden` 只是让持有人在首页、应用切换器和 `app:launcher` 里看不到该应用(网址仍能打开);应用 `requiredPermissions` 加权限集 `systemPermissions` 才是能不能打开(管理员也要有这项授权);应用自身的 `hidden: true` 是对所有人隐藏;没有「按岗位设默认应用」。`SKILL.md` 的 App Navigation 加一句指针,`objectstack-data` 的 `rules/security.md` 在权限集下加一行,评测加用例 17。
- 为什么改:已发布的技能从没提过 `tabPermissions`,HotCRM 的 agent 因此对维护者说「平台做不到按岗位显示不同应用」,实际平台做得到(卡内 M14、M15)。
- 风险与回滚:只改技能文字、一条评测和一个 changeset,不动运行时,也不动 token 天花板;新增文字全部靠同文件删减付清。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:① `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md` 新增的一节(逐条出处见下表);② 同文件被删的五处(`hidden` 与 `defaultAgent` 注释、Rule of thumb 引用块等,理由见 "Deletions");③ `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` 的四处小删减。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期三份文件都在天花板内:`objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` 3814/3814、`rules/navigation.md` 2179/2184、`objectstack-data/rules/security.md` 3959/3959,末行 `57 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings`。
- 需要你做的:本 PR 触 `skills/**`,属 Tier H,保持 draft;等席位的契约复核记录出来后由你合并或批准,现在不需要动作。

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md`: new § Who sees or opens an app, after the `App.create` example.
  - Visibility per audience: `tabPermissions: { crm_enterprise: 'hidden' }` on a permission set, keyed by the app's `name`. The app leaves the holders' Home tiles, App Switcher and `app:launcher` block; `GET /api/v1/me/apps` drops it, `/api/v1/meta/app` still serves it and its URL still opens.
  - The merge rule: any other value for that app on another set the person holds (`visible`, `default_on`, `default_off`) outranks `hidden`, so the set everyone holds must carry no `tabPermissions` entry for it.
  - Access: app `requiredPermissions` plus a `systemPermissions` grant on the holders' permission set; nobody else is served the app (`403` by name), administrators included until a set grants them the capability.
  - Everyone: the app's own `hidden: true` (moved here from the example's comment).
  - No per-position default app: an app's `isDefault: true` is global.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` § App Navigation: a pointer naming `tabPermissions` and app `requiredPermissions`, linking the new section.
- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md`: one bullet under the permission-set bits, pointing at objectstack-ui → Navigation.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json`: case 17, "sales reps must not see the Service app", which also asks for a per-position default and expects the answer to say none exists.
- `.changeset/skills-ui-app-visibility-access.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch.

### Taught claims and their sources (tree `e5428312`; line numbers re-read on head `66066d80`, merge base `ac7b9d80`, by the contract review 6818999356)

### Card vs main

- The card words the merge trap as "the everyone-held set must not carry these keys". On `main` only a more visible value cancels a hide: `hidden` ranks lowest (`tabRank`), so a `visible`, `default_on` or `default_off` entry on any other set a person holds wins. The section teaches that full rule (round 1, head `66066d80`): any other value for that app on another held set outranks `hidden`, so the set everyone holds carries no `tabPermissions` entry for it.
- M14, M15 and M8 all hold on `main` as the card states them; none is softened.

### Deletions that pay for the new text (no ceiling moves)

Token ratchet, `ceil(utf8 bytes / 4)`, measured by `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`:

| File | Before | After | Ceiling |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|

| `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/navigation.md` | 2184 | 2179 | 2184 |
| `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` | 3959 | 3959 | 3959 |

`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` is not in this diff.

- `navigation.md`:
  - the `hidden: true` comment of the `App.create` example: its content is now the "Everyone" bullet of the new section;
  - the five-line `defaultAgent` comment, cut to one line that keeps the rule (only `ask`, the default, or `build` binds; ADR-0063 §2) and points at objectstack-ai, whose SKILL.md teaches the two agents in full;
  - the closing "Rule of thumb" blockquote of Record Presentation: it repeated that section's opening paragraph, and the overrides it named (`navigation.mode`, `size`) are taught by `rules/record-page.md` §5-6, which the section already links;
  - ", but new pages define `columns`/`sort`/`filterBy` on the page": the same paragraph already says the page carries its own `columns` / `sort` / `filterBy`;
  - the code comment "the page IS the view definition": the bold sentence above the example says it;
  - (round 1) the aside "(Airtable parity — there is no \"inherit from a named view\" concept)": the `sourceView` sentence right after it says the same;
  - ", so rung 3 is an exception, never a default": the bullet opens with "reach for them last" and limits rung 3 to a named-customer requirement.
- `SKILL.md` § App Navigation: the sentence "An App groups objects, dashboards, reports, and custom pages into a structured navigation tree", which the Navigation Item Types table below it enumerates. 14 tokens of existing headroom are also spent.
- `security.md`: "(definePermissionSet)" on a comment under the file's first `definePermissionSet` example; "a policy reads the set with `in`" above code that does exactly that; "an AND-gate that is" after "holds ALL listed capabilities"; "neither works alone" before two sentences that say what each key does alone.

## Tests

No runtime code changes, so no unit test changes and no ablation (documentation). The two `os:check` blocks this diff touches (comments only, both in `rules/navigation.md`) type-check: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples` → `345 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)`, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`, at head `c4783421`.

The eval case follows the two rules the repository holds eval fixtures to: every `must_contain` token (`tabPermissions`, `'hidden'`, `requiredPermissions`, `systemPermissions`) is a whole token in the bundle's own markdown, and neither `must_not_contain` entry (`hidden: true,` / `hidden: true }`, the inline forms a wrong answer writes on the app) appears in the case's own `expected_output`. `ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs` reads the `objectui` bundle only (130 rows, none from `objectstack-ui`), so this is a hand check, not a gate reading.

## Acceptance notes

- `tabPermissions` accepts `visible`, `default_on` and `default_off` beside `hidden`. Reading the code, only `hidden` has a consumer (`useLauncherApps.tsx` L39: "`default_off` is not read here: it is not a hide"); the other three only outrank it in the merge. The schema text describes `default_off` as "available but hidden initially" (`packages/spec/src/security/permission.zod.ts` L1299-1300). Read-only inference, not measured at a public door, so noted here and not filed. The section teaches `hidden` and the merge only.
- A `tabPermissions` key is a free string: no lint rule in `packages/lint/src` reads the key (`git grep -c tabPermissions -- packages/lint/src`: 0 files), so a mistyped app name is inert. Read-only inference, noted only.
- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/security.md` still says "permission set / profile" (L60) and "an app-declared default profile" (L314-315), while `isProfile` is a retired key (`permission.zod.ts`, the tombstone citing ADR-0090 D2). Wording outside this card, left untouched.
